MOD = 10**9 + 7

def count_sequences(N, K):
    # dp[i][j] represents the number of sequences of length i ending with the number j
    dp = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(K + 1)]
    
    # Base case: for sequences of length 1, any number from 1 to N can be the sequence
    for j in range(1, N + 1):
        dp[1][j] = 1

    # Fill the dp table
    for i in range(2, K + 1):  # sequences of length 2 to K
        for j in range(1, N + 1):  # ending element
            dp[i][j] = 0
            for k in range(1, N + 1):  # previous element
                if j * k <= N:
                    dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][k]) % MOD

    # Sum up all sequences of length K
    result = sum(dp[K][j] for j in range(1, N + 1)) % MOD
    return result

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().strip().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    print(count_sequences(N, K))
